signals.title: Claude Code hardens pre-approval file and permission-preview trust boundaries
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 加固预审批文件访问与权限预览信任边界
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.234 rejects Windows NT-namespace paths across pre-approval file reads and related restore/include/upload paths, while permission previews are relayed only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate and preserve decision-relevant commands, paths and destinations under redaction.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.234 在预审批文件读取以及相关恢复、include、上传路径上拒绝 Windows NT-namespace 路径；权限预览仅转发给通过入站信任门禁的频道服务器，并确保脱敏不会遮蔽审批所需的命令、路径和目标信息。

signals.title: Claude Code preserves permission state across background subagents and TUI transitions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在后台子 Agent 与 TUI 切换中保持权限状态
signals.summary: The release fixes session-scoped permission answers, including denies, being dropped while answering background-subagent prompts, and prevents TUI restarts from silently losing launch-time tool restrictions when those restrictions cannot be carried over.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本修复了回答后台子 Agent 工具权限提示时丢失会话级权限答案（包括拒绝）的情况，并在 TUI 无法继承启动时工具限制时拒绝静默重启，避免权限状态被跨界丢失。

signals.title: Codex turns the shared agents overview into a background task control surface
signals.title_zh: Codex 将共享 Agents Overview 升级为后台任务控制面
signals.summary: Codex's shared agents overview can start, open, rename and stop root tasks while preserving draft input and pending server requests as users switch sessions, allowing running roots and their subagents to continue in the background.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的共享 Agents Overview 现在可直接启动、打开、重命名和停止根任务，并在切换会话时保存草稿输入和待处理服务器请求，使运行中的根任务及其子 Agent 能继续后台执行。

signals.title: Codex durable thread queues wake idle sessions after cross-process writes
signals.title_zh: Codex 持久线程队列可在跨进程写入后唤醒空闲会话
signals.summary: Codex adds durable queue revisions and SQLite data-version checks so loaded idle threads can discover messages inserted or edited by another process, wake pending external work, and retry queues independently instead of letting one blocked queue stall others.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为线程队列增加持久 Revision 与 SQLite data-version 检查，使已加载的空闲线程能够发现其他进程插入或编辑的消息、唤醒外部待办，并按线程独立重试，避免单个阻塞队列拖住其他任务。

signals.title: Codex surfaces approval and input requests into realtime conversations
signals.title_zh: Codex 将审批与输入请求显式映射到实时会话
signals.summary: Execution, permission and patch approvals plus user-input and elicitation requests are mirrored into active realtime conversations with serialized request details, making pending human decisions visible without silently consuming them.
signals.summary_zh: 执行、权限、补丁审批以及用户输入和 Elicitation 请求会携带序列化请求详情映射到活跃实时会话中，使待处理的人类决策显式可见，而不是被静默消费。

signals.title: Codex drops all Linux capabilities before sandboxed command execution
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Linux 沙箱命令执行前清空全部 Capability
signals.summary: Both bubblewrap launch modes now pass --cap-drop ALL, and the inner sandbox stage verifies effective and permitted Linux capability sets are empty before executing the requested command, aborting otherwise.
signals.summary_zh: 两种 bubblewrap 启动模式现在都会传入 --cap-drop ALL，并在真正执行请求命令前由沙箱内部阶段核验 Linux Effective/Permitted Capability 集为空，否则直接中止。

signals.title: Codex confines MCP HTTP redirects to the configured origin
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 MCP HTTP 重定向限制在配置源站内
signals.summary: MCP HTTP redirect handling now validates every hop against the configured server origin, requires HTTPS for non-loopback hostname redirects, shares the original timeout, enforces a hop limit and avoids replaying plaintext proxy credentials across redirects.
signals.summary_zh: MCP HTTP 重定向现在逐跳核验目标是否仍属于配置服务器源站；非 Loopback 主机名的重定向必须使用 HTTPS，同时共享原始超时、限制跳数，并避免跨重定向重放明文代理凭证。

signals.title: Codex traces exec-server requests from receipt through terminal outcome
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Exec Server 请求从接收到终态进行全链路追踪
signals.summary: Inbound exec-server request spans now begin when messages enter the connection queue and continue through dispatch and response handling, with bounded-route queue-duration telemetry and outcome recording for completed, rejected, cancelled, error and disconnect paths.
signals.summary_zh: Exec Server 入站请求在进入连接队列时即开始 Span，并贯穿调度和响应处理；同时增加按有界 Route 标记的队列时长指标，并记录完成、拒绝、取消、错误与断连等终态。

signals.title: Google ADK blocks remote A2A peers from self-approving dangerous tool calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止远程 A2A 对端自批危险工具调用
signals.summary: ADK now marks every A2A-originated invocation even when the peer sends no metadata and ignores tool-confirmation responses arriving over A2A, closing a path where a remote peer could satisfy a human-in-the-loop confirmation for a pending dangerous tool call.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在即使远程对端不携带 Metadata，也会标记调用来自 A2A，并忽略经 A2A 到达的工具确认响应，从而封堵远程对端替代真人完成危险工具调用 HITL 审批的路径。

signals.title: Google ADK correctly resumes live sessions from caller-supplied handles
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 使用调用方 Handle 正确恢复 Live Session
signals.summary: ADK seeds the live invocation with a caller-provided session-resumption handle before the first connect loop, so an existing server-side conversation is not replayed and an early socket drop can reconnect before the server has issued a new handle.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 在首次连接循环前将调用方提供的 Session Resumption Handle 注入 Live Invocation，使服务器已有的会话历史不被重复回放，并允许首次连接在服务器尚未下发新 Handle 时发生断连后继续恢复。

signals.title: Gemini CLI enforces the agents feature gate before loading built-in subagents
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在加载内置子 Agent 前强制执行 Agents Feature Gate
signals.summary: Gemini CLI moves built-in-agent loading behind the enableAgents check and prevents refresh from reloading agents while the feature is disabled, so disabling agents now actually yields an empty registry unless explicitly overridden by supported policy.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 将内置 Agent 加载移到 enableAgents 检查之后，并禁止在 Agents 功能关闭时通过 Refresh 重新加载，从而使“禁用 Agents”真正落实为空 Registry，而不是仅停用部分路径。

signals.title: Gemini CLI bounds IDE process discovery with execution timeouts
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 为 IDE 进程探测增加有界执行超时
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now bounds process-table discovery commands with 3-second Unix and 5-second Windows timeouts and handles timeout failures, removing an indefinite-hang path in IDE integration startup and diagnostics.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在为进程表探测设置 Unix 3 秒、Windows 5 秒超时并处理超时失败，消除 IDE 集成启动和诊断中的一个无限挂起路径。

signals.title: Codex restores Guardian risk state when threads resume or fork
signals.title_zh: Codex 在线程恢复或分叉时恢复 Guardian 风险状态
signals.summary: Resumed and forked Codex threads now initialize SecurityRiskScore from the latest persisted rollout history when no explicit score is supplied, preserving approval-routing state instead of silently resetting governance context across thread lifecycles.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的恢复线程与分叉线程在未显式提供分数时，会从最近的持久化 Rollout 历史恢复 SecurityRiskScore，避免跨线程生命周期静默重置审批路由所依赖的治理状态。

signals.title: Codex applies effective user MCP policy to executor plugins
signals.title_zh: Codex 将有效用户 MCP 策略落实到 Executor Plugin
signals.summary: Executor-plugin MCP roots now inherit effective user server enablement, tool allow/deny lists and default/per-tool approval modes while preserving stricter plugin-declared restrictions, aligning selected execution plugins with the same governed MCP policy surface.
signals.summary_zh: Executor Plugin 的 MCP Root 现在继承有效用户配置中的服务器启用状态、工具 Allow/Deny 列表以及默认/逐工具审批模式，同时保留 Plugin 自身更严格的限制，使选定执行插件进入统一 MCP 治理策略面。
